messages:
maya (support): FYI incoming request from AcmeCorp asking for a big quota boost for a 2-week pilot. ticket #123987. they want 5x tokens/sec starting tomorrow morning.
liam (sales): AcmeCorp is a high-value prospect, pilot tied to procurement timeline. would be great to support but we need safety controls.
noah (product): Need details: what endpoints, expected peak QPS, duration, and business justification. Also: any data residency or opt-in terms? We should avoid permanent config change without contract.
sara (abuse): On it. please paste request payloads / sample API keys / IP ranges if available. We'll run risk checks (account history, billing, geo, UA, headless browser indicators). If risk_score > 0.6 we deny and require more verification.
maya (support): Customer says: mainly chat/generation, model "redwood-large-v1", approximate peak 300 req/min, avg 512 tokens/response. They provided IPs: 52.12.34.0/24 and 3.45.67.89, and two API keys that were used in trial: rk_live_ABCxxx.
olivia (eng-sre): We can put a temporary policy in front of them: conditional burst bucket + telemetry. Suggest: grant 2x immediately, 5x for 6 hours behind a toggle with TTL, and add logging/alerts on 429 spikes. Example config snippet:

```
rate_limit:
  default: 100r/s
  temporary_overrides:
    acme_pilot:
      limit: 500r/s
      expires_at: "2026-03-21T18:00:00Z"
      alert_threshold: 0.8
```

olivia (eng-sre): Also add live metrics to the console route for that customer and webhook for alerting.
sara (abuse): Steps I'm recommending:
1) run automatic checks now (I have tooling) -> will report risk_score + flags
2) if low risk, allow time-limited increase with strict telemetry and TTL
3) require SSO or PO from customer for any >30d increase
4) if any anomaly (sudden token count growth, many unique UAs from same key) auto-revoke

sara (abuse): Running checks... result: risk_score 0.22, flags: unusual UA diversity (7 distinct UAs), IPs include cloud provider ranges (ok), billing history clean.
noah (product): Given risk low and sales urgency, I'm ok with a temporary 5x for 6 hours + monitoring. We must create a short-lived exception flow and follow-up with product backlog item to formalize policy (PROD-1294).
liam (sales): I'll get Acme to sign an NDA addendum and SSO plan. If we get contract in 7 days we can revisit permanent increase.
maya (support): I'll apply the temporary override now and document in the ticket. applying: set override to 500r/s for 6h, attach alerts to #prod-alerts channel, webhook to SupportOps.
incidents-bot: policy-override-created: override_id=ovr-77a3f, expires=1765013576, target=acct-acmecorp, created_by=maya
olivia (eng-sre): Added dashboard panel and realtime alert rule. Also enable per-key blocking if abuse triggers: block_condition = token_rate > 2000 && unique_ips > 10 within 5m.
noah (product): Capture learnings: need an internal playbook for pilot quota requests (triage checklist + templates). Filing PROD-1294: "Quota exception playbook: triage, abuse checks, temporary overrides, SLA gating".
sara (abuse): I'll follow up in the ticket with logs and final recommendation. If anything looks off we revoke immediately.
maya (support): Done. Ticket #123987 updated with override_id ovr-77a3f, expiry 6h from now. Noting follow-up: require SSO + signed addendum for permanent increase. :thumbsup:
liam (sales): Awesome, thanks team. I'll coordinate contract. :party-parrot:
maya (support): closing loop here. monitoring in place, support on watch.
